n: <int> Total number of variables across both the leader and the follower.
n1: <int> Number of variables controlled by the leader.
n2: <int> Number of variables controlled by the follower.
all_leader_vars_integer: <bool> Whether all leader variables are restricted to nonnegative integer values.
leader_follower_objective_coefficients_f: <bool, must be true> This released benchmark fixes every d1 coefficient on follower variables in the leader objective to zero.
num_integer_follower_vars: <int> Number of follower variables that are restricted to nonnegative integer values.
integer_follower_vars: <list[int], length num_integer_follower_vars> One-based indices identifying which follower variables must take nonnegative integer values.
c: <list[int], length n1> Leader's objective function coefficients applied to the leader's variables.
d2: <list[int], length n2> Follower's objective function coefficients applied only to the follower objective.
A1: <list[list[int]], shape [m1][n1]> Upper-level constraint coefficients applied to the leader's variables.
B1: <list[list[int]], shape [m1][n2]> Upper-level constraint coefficients applied to the follower's variables.
b1: <list[int], length m1> Right-hand side limits for the upper-level constraints.
A2: <list[list[int]], shape [m2][n1]> Lower-level constraint coefficients applied to the leader's variables.
B2: <list[list[int]], shape [m2][n2]> Lower-level constraint coefficients applied to the follower's variables.
b2: <list[int], length m2> Right-hand side limits for the lower-level constraints.
